sources.entry: iStats - Command-line system information tool. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/Chris911/iStats)

summary.one_liner: iStats is a command-line tool for macOS (OS X) that prints CPU temperature, fan speeds, and battery information, installed via RubyGems.
summary.what_it_does: iStats reads system sensors and prints CPU temperature, fan speed, and battery stats from the terminal. Subcommands cover all stats or individual items such as CPU temperature, fan speed, battery health, time remaining, cycle count, charge, and capacity. A "scan" command lists SMC temperature keys, and "enable", "disable", and "list" manage extra sensors for advanced users. Output can be shown as sparkline graphs, labels, or scaled values, with an option for Fahrenheit. A "scan zabbix" mode emits JSON for Zabbix low-level discovery, with template and agent config in an integrations directory.
use_cases: check Mac CPU temperature from the terminal
monitor fan speeds on a MacBook
view battery health and cycle count
feed Mac sensor data into Zabbix monitoring
list and enable SMC temperature sensors
how_to_run: sudo ARCHFLAGS=-Wno-error=unused-command-line-argument-hard-error-in-future gem install iStats (older OS X versions, if the install fails)
notable: Single command-line tool for CPU temperature, fan speed, and battery stats on macOS
Optional advanced SMC sensor scanning with enable/disable per key
Sparkline graph output that can be turned off with flags
JSON output for Zabbix low-level discovery
caveats: Only runs on OS X / macOS; the README names no other platforms.
Installation may fail on older OS X versions and may need a workaround flag.
Tested only on a few MacBook Pro and Mac Pro models with OS X 10.9 to 10.12 and Ruby 1.9.3 to 2.4.1.
